## ClaudeMC v1.8

**Minecraft:** 1.21.1 · **Fabric Loader:** 0.16.5 · **Fabric API:** 0.100.7+1.21.1 · **Java:** 21

> **First release to include a compiled `.jar`** — download `claudemc-1.8.0.jar` from the assets below and drop it into your `mods/` folder alongside Fabric API. No building required.

### New in v1.8

#### Chat Overlay (UIUtils)
Press **`T`** while **any GUI is open** (auction house, crafting table, chest, etc.) to open a floating chat input box without closing the current screen.  
Enter = send · Esc = dismiss · Full cursor editing supported.  
Prepend `/` for commands.

#### Macros
Open ClickGUI → `[Macros]`.  
- Create macros with a name, a command/chat string, and an optional keybind  
- Press the keybind in-game to fire the macro instantly  
- Right-click any row to delete  
- Saved to `config/claudemc/macros.json`

#### Alt Manager
Open ClickGUI → `[Alts]`.  
- **Offline alts** — any username, works on cracked/offline-mode servers  
- **Session alts** — paste a UUID + access token for Microsoft accounts (token obtained externally)  
- Click a row to switch; `[Restore]` returns to your original session  
- Saved to `config/claudemc/alts.json`

#### MiniMessageExploit (Misc module)
Sends crafted MiniMessage-tagged payloads to plugins that parse user input without sanitising tags (EssentialsX < 2.21.0, some chat plugins).  
Based on: [khaodoes.dev/blog/minimessage-escape-exploit](https://khaodoes.dev/blog/minimessage-escape-exploit)  
5 techniques: ClickCommand · HoverSpoof · GradientBypass · EscapeInject · FontObfuscate  
One-shot — auto-disables after firing.

#### ServerCrash (Misc module)
Packet-based crash techniques for unpatched Spigot/CraftBukkit:
- **BookOverflow** — 100-page max-length book NBT crash
- **PacketFlood** — rapid close-screen packet queue overflow  
- **NBTOverflow** — 512-level deep nested NBT  
- **SignOverflow** — oversized sign text  
Patched on Paper 1.19.3+. One-shot — auto-disables.

#### Mod Compatibility guide
README now documents compatible mods (Sodium, Lithium, ModMenu, Replay Mod) and incompatible ones (OptiFabric, Iris ESP caveat, Meteor/Wurst conflict, Essential mod conflict).

#### Build pipeline fix
CI now runs `./gradlew build` via Java 21 (Temurin) on every VERSION bump and attaches the compiled JAR to the release. No more source-only releases.
